cards.intuition: Each stage records the newest source timestamp it has fully processed; lag is just now minus that mark, emitted per stage and per big tenant.
cards.topic: Freshness SLAs and Lag Metrics for Ingestion and Index Builds

cards.intuition: A six-hour rebuild births an index that is already six hours stale, so build from a snapshot and replay events since it before the alias swaps.
cards.formula: publish = snapshot timestamp + replay of later events
cards.topic: Freshness SLAs and Lag Metrics for Ingestion and Index Builds

cards.intuition: A lag that keeps doubling means the consumer is losing to the producer; alert on the growth before the SLA itself breaks.
cards.formula: rising lag = falling behind, alert early
cards.topic: Freshness SLAs and Lag Metrics for Ingestion and Index Builds

cards.intuition: The fraction of queries returning nothing useful is the earliest warning a retrieval system has; it moves before complaints do.
cards.formula: zero-hit = queries with no useful result / all queries
cards.topic: Production Retrieval Metrics: Hit Rate, MRR, Reranker Scores

cards.intuition: Track reranker top-1 and top-50 score percentiles daily; a shift with no deploy means the inputs changed, not the code.
cards.formula: distribution shift, no deploy = input drift
cards.topic: Production Retrieval Metrics: Hit Rate, MRR, Reranker Scores

cards.intuition: Count candidates after every stage: per source, post-ACL, post-dedupe, post-rerank. A stage that suddenly emits less has an address.
cards.formula: counts per stage boundary, watched over time
cards.topic: Production Retrieval Metrics: Hit Rate, MRR, Reranker Scores

cards.intuition: Run golden queries on old and new index, compare paired by query, and reject the change if any query class regresses past its threshold.
cards.formula: paired per-class comparison, no class regresses
cards.topic: Golden Query Sets and Regression Canaries for Index Changes

cards.intuition: Plant documents with known behavior and query them every minute; a freshness canary updates hourly and measures time-to-visibility end to end.
cards.formula: canary miss = live defect, mapped to a layer
cards.topic: Golden Query Sets and Regression Canaries for Index Changes

cards.intuition: Golden sets rot as language evolves, so review quarterly and add every incident's queries; tune never on the held-out slice.
cards.formula: tuning set for tuning, held-out for validation
cards.topic: Golden Query Sets and Regression Canaries for Index Changes

cards.intuition: Gradual and segment-concentrated is drift; step change on a build timestamp is a defect; uniform shift or metric-only movement is a model or judge change.
cards.formula: drift = gradual+segmented, defect = step+timestamp, model = uniform
cards.topic: Diagnosing Quality Drops: Data Drift vs Index Defect vs Model Change

cards.intuition: When did it start, does it reproduce offline, which canaries fired, which stage's output changed, which segments hurt. In that order.
cards.formula: when -> offline repro -> canaries -> attrition -> segments
cards.topic: Diagnosing Quality Drops: Data Drift vs Index Defect vs Model Change

cards.intuition: Every diagnosis ends by adding the metric or canary that would have caught it earlier, so the next incident is faster than the last.
cards.topic: Diagnosing Quality Drops: Data Drift vs Index Defect vs Model Change
